claim_being_audited: Whether rejecting the vendor was policy-compliant and adequately supported by admissible due-diligence evidence showing a material unresolved risk, rather than by weaker indicators such as documentation gaps, questionnaire inconsistency, or informal quality processes alone.
specific_concerns: The actor's own packet describes support as weak and acknowledges there is no formally logged failed control test.
The policy requires admissible evidence of a material unresolved risk; the summary shows unresolved concerns, but materiality is not clearly established from the admissible record alone.
Questionnaire inconsistency and informal quality-process documentation support follow-up or escalation under the policy, but do not by themselves prove a reject-level control failure.

The procurement note appears conditional: follow-up before approval if storage controls remained unresolved. That supports withholding approval pending resolution more clearly than permanent rejection.
Because evidence access is limited to the actor summary, the support link from diligence concerns to a reject-level decision is not fully demonstrated.
unsupported_claims: Any implication that the record proves a confirmed storage-control failure.
Any implication that quality-process informality alone satisfied the reject threshold.
Any reliance on unlogged private security-review results or equivalent non-admissible findings, if such reasoning influenced the rejection beyond the cited record.
evidence_requests: The underlying text of BPROC-001-B through BPROC-001-E, especially the exact storage-control inconsistency and the procurement follow-up note.
A contemporaneous record showing why the unresolved storage issue was considered material rather than routine or remediable.
Any documented escalation, risk-rating, or approval memo linking the unresolved controls to a reject decision.
Any admissible evidence showing the vendor failed to cure the issue after follow-up was requested.
Any formal procurement policy guidance distinguishing reject from hold, conditional approval, or further diligence in this fact pattern.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows a material unresolved risk sufficient for rejection under policy.
Treat questionnaire inconsistencies and quality-process gaps as support for follow-up/escalation unless the record shows they rose to material unresolved risk.
Do not credit private or unlogged security-review conclusions.
Assess whether the cited evidence supports rejection specifically, not merely caution or delay.
Downgrade when the actor overclaims beyond what the admissible record establishes.
